text: ITEM 1 | Single irregular piece with a pale cream-white inner section on top, covered by a golden-brown, crispy breaded coating with visible small granular crumbs and darker brown edges; matte surface with slight oil sheen, piece roughly 7 cm long by 4 cm wide and about 2.5 cm tall at its thickest, with a ragged, torn edge extending to the right into a thinner flake; sits alone in the center of a white square plate, with a few stray crumbs scattered on the plate to the upper left | 75
